Landmarks include the iconic, century-old Palm Walk; Old Main, the oldest original campus building; Mountain America Stadium and ASU’s other Big 12 athletic venues; the ASU Art Museum, a leading contemporary art museum; and the Frank Lloyd Wright-designed ASU Gammage, a world-class performing arts venue. Overlooking campus is Hayden Butte, also known as “A” Mountain, a focal point for the city of Tempe and symbolic to student experiences such as Echo from the Buttes and the ASU Lantern Walk.
